title: LLMiser Profiles: Standard, Clean, Compact, RAG-ready
reader_task: Understand what each LLMiser output profile actually changes in converted Markdown, from a same-file comparison, and choose one based on document content.
scope_exclusions: No retrieval tuning, chunk-size or top-K advice (E05)
Standard versus Clean diff, Compact byte check and RAG marker placement in depth belong to M08-S1, S2, S3
No claim that RAG-ready embeds, indexes or retrieves
description: LLMiser processing profiles compared on one file: what Standard, Clean, Compact and RAG-ready actually change, where Compact breaks tables, and how to choose.
description_change: Rewritten around the same-file comparison; contains the primary keyword; 159 characters.
excerpt: We ran one Markdown file through all four profiles and compared every line. Clean was the smallest. Compact broke a table. RAG-ready marked a line inside code.
